title: Possession sentences with plural owners
focus: Build plural-owner possession statements: owner + on + one thing.

exercises.prompt: Repair “Heillä ovat peli.” to mean “They have a game.” Use heillä ("they as owner") and peli ("game").
exercises.explanation: The possessor does not conjugate the verb: every owner uses fixed on.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Affirmative possession sentences: form or meaning confused

The possessor does not conjugate the verb: every owner uses fixed on.

This changes possession to its opposite.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: possessor + fixed on + one thing in its basic singular form

parts.role: possessor: the person who has the thing
parts.formation: he has the learned possession form heillä; its -lla/-llä ending marks the possessor. Learn this pronoun form as a whole.
Olla means “to be”; possession uses its fixed on form with every owner, including we and they.
peli stays in its basic singular form: one game.
